rules.name: Monitor High ROAS Gap
rules.reason: The platform is underclaiming ROAS significantly. Consider reviewing attribution windows.

rules.name: Verify Low ROAS Campaigns
rules.reason: Campaigns with low platform-reported ROAS should be verified against true ROAS data.

rules.name: Assess Refund Rate Before Launch
rules.reason: High refund rates could indicate potential product issues or customer dissatisfaction.

rules.name: Monitor Sentiment Mismatch
rules.reason: Significant differences between predicted and actual sentiment need investigation.

rules.name: Monitor High CX Risk Score
rules.reason: A high CX risk score indicates potential issues in customer experience.

rules.name: Inventory Confirmation Needed
rules.reason: Low confirmed inventory levels could lead to stockouts post-launch.

rules.name: Evaluate Health Score
rules.reason: A low health score signals potential issues affecting customer retention.

rules.name: Support Tickets Spike
rules.reason: A spike in support tickets can indicate customer dissatisfaction or issues with a recent product launch.

rules.name: Review Low NPS
rules.reason: Low NPS scores suggest dissatisfaction, requiring immediate attention.

rules.name: Review Negative Review Sentiment
rules.reason: Negative review sentiments could impact brand reputation and sales.

rules.name: Target Social Reach
rules.reason: Low social reach could result in reduced brand awareness and campaign effectiveness.

rules.name: Improve Social to Acquisition Rate
rules.reason: A low conversion rate from social media to acquisitions suggests inefficiencies in engagement tactics.
